releases.body:
Update for OpenCode 1.16, migrate to keymap API, add tests and compaction hooks
- Bump @opencode-ai/plugin and sdk to ^1.16.2
- Move @opentui/* and solid-js to peerDependencies (>=0.3.2), add @opentui/keymap; pin dev copies at 0.3.2
- Migrate command palette from deprecated api.command.register to api.keymap.registerLayer, with legacy fallback
- Add experimental.session.compacting hook so goals survive context compaction
- Add experimental.text.complete hook to detect ::GOAL_DONE:: on the stream and skip the extra message fetch
- Add bun test suite for src/core.ts (24 cases) and a CI test job
- Exclude test files from the npm tarball
- Bump to 0.3.0, update README and CHANGELOG

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/martsallan/goal-opencode/compare/v0.2.4...v0.3.0
